name: MyFundAccounting.Online
shortDescription: UK online software for churches and charities to keep separate fund accounts, with church-focused financial administration and optional extra licences.
suitableContexts: Church treasurers and charities needing a church-focused fund-accounting product
Church of England parishes able to use a diocesan accounting offer or template

pricing.summary: The supplier product page publishes £15/month including VAT for the first licence, plus £4/month per additional licence. Diocesan arrangements can have different terms and prices, so check the relevant route before budgeting.

startingPrice.qualifier: First licence, including VAT; £4/month per additional licence is published

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier page offers a free trial; ask the supplier for its current duration.

gdprInformation: The reviewed material includes supplier security statements. Ask for the current data-processing agreement, hosting geography and sub-processor information.
support: Supplier states that technical-support staff monitor its servers 24/7

uk-purchasing.value: Supplier publishes GBP VAT-inclusive pricing and presents the product for UK churches and charities.

gbp-pricing.value: £15/month including VAT for the first licence and £4/month per additional licence are published.

hosting.value: Supplier states that servers are PCI DSS compliant and backed up regularly.

editorial.assessment: MyFundAccounting.Online is a UK church-finance option with a simple published licence price and named diocesan use cases. A treasurer should still compare its reporting, fund structure, bank process, year-end workflow, independent-examination requirements and handover against the church's actual accounts before relying on a product description or diocesan recommendation.
bestFor: Churches seeking a church-focused online fund-accounting product
Church of England parishes where a diocese offers a supported arrangement
Treasurers who prefer published per-licence pricing
strengths: Supplier publishes a GBP VAT-inclusive starting price
The product is presented specifically for churches and charities
Church of England diocesan sources document relevant parish use cases
limitations: Diocesan pricing and support arrangements can differ from the public supplier price
Ask the supplier for data-processing terms, location, export formats, accessibility information or detailed migration support
Supplier security statements are not a financial-control, cyber-security or compliance assessment for an individual church

procurementVerdict.differentiator: Published per-licence pricing and church-specific diocesan use cases
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Test the fund structure, reports, bank reconciliation, year-end and examiner workflow with the actual church accounts

sources.label: Church of England national support page
